stories.text: 🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Stacey's Smart Team has been laid to rest (5.76 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🤝 The trade machine has spoken: Parker Washington and Trey McBride ↔ Chase Brown and D'Andre Swift, a win-win in optimal lineups.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: In My Fantasy Era leads the chopping-block odds at 23%, with Moose Knucklers next at 23%.
🤝 Rivalry week: The Mahomies leads TDsMaGee 5–3 all-time, and The Mahomies has won the last 2.
🥊 Heavyweight bout: #1 Brock You Like a Hurricane (4–0) meets #3 Gibb it to Me Baby (3–1).
🤝 Rivalry week: Ruffing the Passer leads Kyle Tucker 6–1 all-time, and Ruffing the Passer has won the last 3.
🚑 INJURY WARD: Ramosverse is absolutely slammed — Achane (Rd 1), Smith (Rd 3) and Hall (Rd 4) are out.
🏈 6 matchups are still up for grabs, and Mr. Action Jackson vs 49er Faith-Fool (Mr. Action Jackson 59%) is the tightest.
🎤 BYE BYE BYE: Ruffing the Passer has 2 starters on bye this week (Hubbard and Chiefs D/ST). The Mahomies is feeling it too. Somebody call *NSYNC.
🥶 Kirbo Crushers has dropped 4 straight. Can they snap it against Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy?
🏆 Title odds entering Week 5: Brock You Like a Hurricane 32%, Gibb it to Me Baby 24%, Mr. Action Jackson 10%.
💡 Trade idea: Ramosverse's Jake Ferguson for TDsMaGee's RJ Harvey. Swapping them would have led to 1 more win each in their optimal lineups.
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 16% against The Mahomies — and won.
